question: Can one event-preserving guitar candidate fit four of its own P1 training examples, including a repeated same-string/same-fret attack, within a hard 200-step budget?

scope.captureSelectionRule: For each primary content class in order chords, scales, singlenotes, techniques: choose the lexicographically first P1 performance represented in the frozen alignment corrections, then choose view priority directinput, micamp, ego, exo. No model outputs are consulted.
scope.cropSelectionRule: After capture identity is frozen, source events may choose a training-only crop: earliest crop-capable same-string/same-fret repeated attack pair; otherwise earliest resolved source attack. This is deliberate fitting coverage and is forbidden as validation/generalization evidence.

eventPreparation.source: frozen midi_string_events tuple output plus exact frozen alignment correction
eventPreparation.carryIn: retain occupancy, no crop-edge onset, exclude event from event/offset scoring
eventPreparation.carryOut: retain source onset if inside crop, exclude event from event/offset scoring
eventPreparation.registeredMasks: event intersecting mask is excluded whole from scoring and its full in-crop occupancy is loss-masked
eventPreparation.subFrameAttack: explicit unresolved issue, never silently drop
eventPreparation.frameGridCollision: explicit unresolved issue and loss mask
eventPreparation.outOfCropSourceIssues: reported but do not veto an unrelated selected crop

model.stateHead: Linear(128,126), six independent 21-class string states after reshape

objective.onsetLoss: masked binary cross entropy from explicit source attack targets

decoder.sameFretReattack: an admitted onset closes the current event and starts a new event even if fret identity is unchanged
decoder.fretChangeWithoutOnset: close current event but do not invent a new one

diagnostics: initial and final loss per head
matched offset MAE and within-50ms count
stop reason and unresolved label counts

advancement.meaning: engineering learnability screen only; passing permits design of a separate same-budget cross-performer screen, not full training, generalization, P3 access or customer delivery
advancement.onFailure: stop this candidate and retain evidence; investigate inputs, targets or objective; do not add epochs, retry automatically or invent a second candidate inside this pilot
